high_level_description: The image is an illustration of an anime-style character sitting on a wooden bench outdoors. The character has blonde hair styled in two pigtails with red ribbons. She has large blue eyes and is wearing a black dress with a corset-like top that has a cross pendant necklace. The dress features lace sleeves and a ruffled skirt. Her legs are crossed, and she is wearing thigh-high stockings or tights that match the dress. The background shows a lush green park with trees and a clear blue sky, suggesting a pleasant day. There is also a building with large windows partially visible behind the trees.
